votes.motion: Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township meeting held on May 23, 2023, and June 13, 2023. The June 19th, 2023, minutes are deferred for revisions

Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve the following Ordinance No. 2023-O-08, amending the zoning map to change the zone of property located at 2198 South 7400 West, from A-20 (Agricultural) to M-2 (Manufacturing)
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to approve Resolution 2023-07-01
